scope: Noxia initial mark prerequisite; partial aggregate production correction
recovered: Cooldown readiness is checked before hero target and excluded damage-category checks.
A target without Item.Noxia.Stacks receives DamageStackToApply; that branch does not apply DamageEffectToApply.
The marked branch tests Array_AddUnique return value >= 0 before committing and applying damage. This is not an array-length >= 2 test.

Static native trace of the registered Array_AddUnique thunk and its helper: the lookup returns an existing index or -1; the helper returns -1 on the existing-index branch and the new index only after insertion. Thus >=0 rejects previously recorded identities.
The mark effect has duration bound to Noxia.Duration, AggregateBySource and StackLimitCount 1.
productionDecision: Require one setup ability hit before any Noxia proc credit against the initially unmarked single target. Retain the existing global ICD cap; remaining credit is an optimistic aggregate estimate, not event replay.
limits: Mark expiry, per-source ownership and repeated marks after cooldown are not represented.
The new-identity requirement is recovered, but mapping identities to casts/slots and filtering repeated ticks remain unresolved in production.
Existing 6% max-health and 8-second values remain catalog-derived, not newly verified native constants.
No game observation certifies this approximation.

nativeEvidence.identityGetter: PredAbilityLibrary delegates through effect-context virtual dispatch. PredGameplayEffectContext struct operations construct a context with a zero-initialized identity field; its matching virtual getter returns that field. Population, copy behavior and per-cast lifetime remain unresolved.
nativeEvidence.registration: Validated the 32-entry KismetArrayLibrary native registration table and the 19-entry PredAbilityLibrary table against their class constructors; the named entries resolve to the traced thunks.
